name: Nickel City Comic Con
blurb: Buffalo's pop-culture convention with celebrity guests, comic creators and cosplay at the Buffalo Convention Center.

editions.evidence: Homepage text: 'JULY 9-11, 2027 BUFFALO CONVENTION CENTER 153 Franklin St. Buffalo, NY'

notes: Both the Celebrities and Comic Creators pages say only 'KEEP CHECKING BACK!' — no guests announced yet for the July 2027 edition. Site has no og:image or JSON-LD, so the cover uses the largest homepage hero banner instead.
